senses.gloss: (I)--the wife of Brahmadatta and mother of विष्- vaksena. भा. IX. २१. २५.

(II)--created from the belly and sides of the Lord; considered a part of Hari's body. As they supplied milk for हविस्, कंसा resolved to kill them. Nanda gave them as gifts to ब्राह्मणस् during कृष्ण's जातकर्मा.
1: भा. X. 4. ३९-41; 5. 3; M. १३. ५८; Vi. I. 5. ४८.
In their stalls and in places cleaned by their dung श्राद्ध can be performed. Objects of worship.
2: Br. III. १३. १२८-130; २८. ११, ५७ and ६०; IV. 6. ३८ and ४६; ४०. ११६.
गोरक्ष introduced by पृथु;
3: Br. II. ३६. १९८.
their guru was the sun.
4: Vi. V. 1. १४; १०. २६.
born of Surabhi, वृषभ their lord; dharmas pertaining to;
5: M. 6. ४४; 8. 8; ४८. ५२; ५२. १८.
their stall (गोष्ठ) as fit for श्राद्ध offering;
6: Ib. १५. ३३; १६. २२; १७. ११; ८३. १०.
their horn used for washing images, esp. of शिव.
7: Ib. ५६. 6; ६०. ३३.
